user.title: Sophos Firewall (REST)
user.description: Create an API key on the firewall: Administration > API access.

init.title: Options
init.description: SNMP v2c community for live data (CPU, memory, temperature, link state, traffic); leave empty to turn SNMP off. The trap receiver uses the same community. Below: the DHCP servers that the actions may change.

data.dhcp_write_servers: DHCP servers that actions may change

data_description.dhcp_write_servers: Only the selected servers can be changed with the add/remove reservation actions.
data_description.trap_enabled: Every trap from the firewall becomes the event sophos_rest_trap, usable as an automation trigger. Set this Home Assistant as trap receiver on the firewall.

error.snmp_failed: No answer from the SNMP agent (check community, port and the SNMP settings on the firewall)
error.trap_needs_community: The trap receiver needs the SNMP community

add_dhcp_reservation.description: Adds a static DHCP reservation. Only on servers allowed in the options; the IP must lie outside the dynamic pools.

set_dhcp_pools.name: Set DHCP pools
set_dhcp_pools.description: Replaces the dynamic address pools of a DHCP server. Only on servers allowed in the options; no reservation may lie inside a pool.

set_dhcp_lease_time.name: Set DHCP lease time
set_dhcp_lease_time.description: Changes the default and maximum lease time of a DHCP server, in minutes. Only on servers allowed in the options. Devices pick up the new time at their next renewal.
